entries.194e502e3788d129: This is the Group's core business, conducting freight trucking, rail freight forwarding, air freight forwarding, marine transportation, harbor transportation, warehousing and other businesses in regions in Japan and overseas. Five areas, “Japan,” “Americas,” “Europe,” “East Asia,” and “South Asia and Oceania,” are its reportable segments. The companies carrying out this business are Nippon Express Co., Ltd. and NX America Co., Ltd., along with 275 other companies. Revenue from external customers for the Group as a whole, by product and service (fiscal year ended December 2025), was ¥535,234 million for air transportation, ¥462,007 million for warehousing and distribution processing, ¥396,327 million for marine transportation, and ¥352,467 million for motor vehicle transportation.

entries.3534340a51ea10d4: By product and service, revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was largest for air transport (¥535,234 million), followed by warehousing and distribution processing (¥462,007 million), sea transport (¥396,327 million), road transport (¥352,467 million) and petroleum and other sales (¥219,409 million); other items include railway handling, relocation and moving, in-plant work, consolidated freight, real estate leasing, art objects, security transport and heavy equipment construction. The company explains that because it uses a wide range of transport modes and engages in both actual carriage and freight forwarding, it is difficult to show sales results by transport mode in relation to its segment information. Forwarding volumes were 933,000 t for air in 2025 (921,000 t in 2024) and 851,000 TEU for sea (899,000 TEU in 2024). Warehousing and delivery revenue was ¥497.4 billion (¥481.8 billion in 2024) and excludes cargo-partner and Simon Hegele.

entries.9182a85645cfd193: For 2037, its 100th anniversary, it has set as its long-term vision a “logistics company with presence in global markets” and has a long-term target of an overseas revenue ratio of 50% in fiscal 2037. Under its five-year management plan from January 2024, “NX Group Management Plan 2028 Dynamic Growth 2.0,” it sets revenue of ¥3 trillion in fiscal 2028 as its final target and focuses on “accelerating business growth in global markets,” “restructuring the Japan business,” “promoting sustainability management” and “efforts to enhance corporate value.” Globally, the company says it will work on advancing account management and providing End to End solutions, acquiring overseas customer bases through M&A, and expanding its India business. In its Japan business, NIPPON EXPRESS CO., LTD. introduced an in-house company system in January 2025. For enhancing corporate value, the company says it has proceeded with selling low-profit business assets and investment properties, and transferring businesses such as villa-area management.
entries.9228ba0f622f530e: This is a specialized business in which NX Engineering Co., Ltd. and its affiliates conduct transport, erection and installation of heavy objects and related businesses (NX Engineering Co., Ltd. and 2 other companies). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥45,136 million (¥50,021 million in the fiscal year ended December 2024), and revenue including intersegment internal revenue was ¥48.5 billion, a 2.9% decrease from the prior-year period. Handling of shutdown maintenance work and similar increased, while handling of wind power construction-related work declined. As of December 31, 2025, NX Engineering Co., Ltd. was a consolidated subsidiary (voting rights ownership: 100.0%).
entries.97b561090bd33a65: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,574.8 billion (¥2,574,826 million), a decrease of ¥2.8 billion, or 0.1%, from the previous year. It is explained that there was a factor increasing revenue from the Simon Hegele group joining the group, while there was a factor decreasing revenue from the integration of the domestic less-than-truckload business and other changes. Revenue from external customers by reportable segment was Japan ¥1,222,355 million, Europe ¥513,815 million, Logistics Support ¥326,937 million, East Asia ¥147,561 million, South Asia & Oceania ¥129,006 million, Americas ¥121,416 million, Security Transport ¥68,597 million and Heavy Goods Construction ¥45,136 million. By customer location, Japan was ¥1,535,496 million, Europe ¥409,747 million, East Asia ¥260,937 million, Americas ¥216,268 million and South Asia & Oceania ¥152,377 million. The company sets overseas revenue (after consolidation adjustments; the table in the management plan is in hundreds of millions of yen) at 9,117 as the actual result for the fiscal year ended December 2025 and 12,000 as the final target for fiscal 2028, and holds an overseas revenue ratio of 50% in fiscal 2037 as a long-term target.

entries.9db72e6e95a08722: Profit attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,693 million (¥2.6 billion), a decrease of ¥29.0 billion, or 91.5%, from ¥31,733 million in the same period of the previous year. The company explains the decrease as reflecting exchange rate effects and other factors. On segment performance, the company cites cost reduction effects in Japan and East Asia, the impact of various cost increases in Europe and South Asia and Oceania, and the effect of fee revisions in Japan and security transport. Logistics support saw increases in handling across its logistics products, vehicle maintenance and manufacturing, and real estate divisions, and its revenue, including intersegment revenue, rose 6.2% from the same period of the previous year. The company identifies its main funding needs as operating costs such as freight forwarding costs and fuel costs, and growth investments such as new construction and renovation of facilities and M&A.

entries.a173c5dcfd704333: It is a pure holding company established on January 4, 2022 through a single share transfer in which NIPPON EXPRESS CO., LTD. became a wholly owned subsidiary; it manages group companies and conducts operations incidental or related to that management. Its head office is at 2 Kanda-Izumicho, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. NIPPON EXPRESS CO., LTD. is a [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiary]] with a voting rights ownership ratio of 100.0% (as of December 31, 2025). Its businesses consist of the “Logistics Business,” which is its core and conducts road freight transport, rail freight forwarding, air freight forwarding, marine transport, harbor transport and warehousing in Japan and overseas (NIPPON EXPRESS CO., LTD., NX America and 275 companies in total); the specialized “Security Transport Business” (NX Cash Logistics Co., Ltd.); the “Heavy Equipment Construction Business” (NX Engineering Co., Ltd. and two other companies); and the “Logistics Support Business,” which covers sales and real estate businesses (NX Shoji Co., Ltd. and 42 companies in total). Its [[term:segment|reportable segments]] divide the Logistics Business into five (Japan, the Americas, Europe, East Asia, and South Asia and Oceania) and add security transport, heavy equipment construction and logistics support, for eight in total. Its consolidated accounting standard is [[term:ifrs|IFRS Accounting Standards]], its fiscal year ends in December, and consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended December 2025 numbered 77,925 (average temporary employees: 8,226).

NX Sogo Kenkyusho Co., Ltd. conducts research and study services and other businesses, NX Capital Co., Ltd. conducts group finance and other businesses, and NX Career Road Co., Ltd. conducts worker dispatch business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥326,937 million (¥305,020 million in the fiscal year ended December 2024), and revenue including intersegment internal revenue was ¥446.7 billion, a 6.2% increase from the prior-year period. Handling in the logistics products, vehicle maintenance and manufacturing, and real estate divisions increased. By product and service, revenue from external customers for the Group as a whole included ¥219,409 million from petroleum and other sales. As of December 31, 2025, the principal consolidated subsidiaries were NX Trading Co., Ltd., NX Capital Co., Ltd. and NX Career Road Co., Ltd. (all with voting rights ownership of 100.0%), and Osaka Soko Co., Ltd. (79.4%).
